matched.title: Match stats for blocked emails are rolled back when the user save fails

results.judgeReason: Finding #0 points at app/models/blocked_email.rb should_block? and flags that this check writes match_count/last_match_at to the DB while being called as a read/validation predicate. That is the same root cause as the known bug (a predicate with DB-writing side effects). It explains the concrete impact (the writes run inside the user's save transaction and are rolled back, plus a read-modify-write race) and recommends moving the write out of the check, which addresses the planted bug.

matched.title: Kernel#open on an admin-set URL allows shell command execution and local file reads

results.judgeReason: Finding #2 identifies the same root cause: open(url) / open(SiteSetting.feed_polling_url) called on an unvalidated URL with no scheme check, and it explicitly names import_remote's open(url) as having the same flaw. It explains the impact as arbitrary resource access (local file reads, command execution) by way of Kernel#open. That is the same unvalidated open(url) flaw behind the SSRF, even though the finding does not use the word SSRF. The other findings cover XSS, spam topics, URL rewriting, import robustness, and Redis throttling, none of which match.

results.bug: Inconsistent theme color lightness affects visibility

matched.title: Light-theme link color changed from 30% to 70%, and the dark value is inverted

results.judgeReason: The known bug is an inconsistent light/dark lightness value in the scale-color conversion that hurts visibility. Finding #0 points at desktop/topic-post.scss where the light-theme value moved from the original 30% to 70% (and the dark value is correspondingly inverted), breaking the X% -> (100-X)% mapping and washing out the link, which is the same root cause and impact. The other findings describe different, separate lightness changes in other rules.

matched.title: before_validation calls sub! on a possibly nil host and raises NoMethodError

results.judgeReason: Finding #3 points at the before_validation callback in app/models/embeddable_host.rb and says self.host.sub! raises NoMethodError when host is nil. That is the same root cause as the known bug. It also covers the impact: a 500 error instead of a validation error, and valid? cannot be used on a blank record.
